sources.quote: 41 Lyncis, also designated HD 81688 and named Intercrus, is a fifth-magnitude star located in the northern constellation of Ursa Major.

introduction.text: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 10.3 solar radii and 2.70 solar masses (FLAME) and 5,026 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).
